cdc-monitoring.title: CDC: developmental monitoring and screening
cdc-monitoring.scope: Monitoring is different from standardized screening.

cdc-checklists.title: CDC: how to use milestone checklists
cdc-checklists.scope: CDC checklists are not diagnostic tools.

who-care.title: WHO: improving early childhood development
who-care.scope: Responsive caregiving and early learning; not validation of these individual activities.

who-movement.title: WHO: physical activity and sedentary behaviour
who-movement.scope: Population guidance for ages 5 and older, including disability and chronic conditions.

who-under5.title: WHO: movement, sedentary behaviour and sleep under age 5
who-under5.scope: Whole-day guidance; a few journal sessions do not represent the full recommendation.

cdc-connections.title: CDC: improving social connectedness
cdc-connections.scope: Ideas for supportive relationships, not attachment treatment or age deadlines.

cdc-teen.title: CDC: positive parental practices
cdc-teen.scope: Supportive adult relationships and adolescent well-being.

nia-aging.title: NIA: healthy aging
nia-aging.scope: General healthy-aging context; no claim that an activity prevents dementia.

aap-preterm.title: AAP: preterm growth and milestones
aap-preterm.scope: Discuss adjusted age and follow-up with the child’s clinician.

cdc-2-months.title: CDC: milestones by 2 months
cdc-2-months.scope: Age-specific monitoring and caregiver tips. Activity browsing windows and session lengths are editorial, not CDC cutoffs or prescriptions.

cdc-1-year.scope: Age-specific monitoring and caregiver tips. Activity browsing windows and session lengths are editorial, not CDC cutoffs or prescriptions.

cdc-15-months.scope: Age-specific monitoring and caregiver tips. Activity browsing windows and session lengths are editorial, not CDC cutoffs or prescriptions.

cdc-18-months.scope: Age-specific monitoring and caregiver tips. Activity browsing windows and session lengths are editorial, not CDC cutoffs or prescriptions.

cdc-2-years.scope: Age-specific monitoring and caregiver tips. Activity browsing windows and session lengths are editorial, not CDC cutoffs or prescriptions.

cdc-30-months.scope: Age-specific monitoring and caregiver tips. Activity browsing windows and session lengths are editorial, not CDC cutoffs or prescriptions.

cdc-3-years.scope: Age-specific monitoring and caregiver tips. Activity browsing windows and session lengths are editorial, not CDC cutoffs or prescriptions.

cdc-4-years.scope: Age-specific monitoring and caregiver tips. Activity browsing windows and session lengths are editorial, not CDC cutoffs or prescriptions.

cdc-5-years.scope: Age-specific monitoring and caregiver tips. Activity browsing windows and session lengths are editorial, not CDC cutoffs or prescriptions.

who-older-activity.title: WHO: Being active in later adulthood
who-older-activity.scope: General guidance on adapting activity to physical condition. Does not validate this catalog's exact completion thresholds or prerequisite sequence.

nhs-baby-active.title: NHS: keeping babies and toddlers active
nhs-baby-active.scope: Awake tummy time from birth and readiness-based movement.

aap-crawling.title: AAP: movement at 8–12 months
aap-crawling.scope: Alternative mobility, supported standing and safe exploration; crawling is not universal.

cdc-feeding.title: CDC: introducing solid foods
cdc-feeding.scope: Feeding readiness at about six months; no prescribed precision drill.

cdc-choking.title: CDC: choking hazards
cdc-choking.scope: Food preparation, upright seating and continuous supervision.

who-activity-2020.title: WHO: 2020 physical activity guidelines
who-activity-2020.scope: Population activity recommendations; not age-specific exercise tests or loads.

cdc-intensity.title: CDC: measuring activity intensity
cdc-intensity.scope: Relative exertion and talk test, not universal heart-rate zones.

nhs-strength.title: NHS: strength exercises
nhs-strength.scope: Gradual supported strengthening, stable chairs and comfortable movement.

nia-cognition.title: NIA: cognitive health and older adults
nia-cognition.scope: Learning and engagement; commercial games do not establish prevention of cognitive decline.

cdc-sleep.title: CDC: about sleep
cdc-sleep.scope: Sleep duration depends on age; 6–12 years: 9–12 hours; 13–17: 8–10 hours.

cfpb-savings.title: CFPB: building an emergency fund
cfpb-savings.scope: Savings goals depend on individual resources and circumstances.

cdc-toddlers-2-3.title: CDC: toddler development, ages two to three
cdc-toddlers-2-3.scope: Supports third-year toddler grouping, not individual activity validation.

nlm-toddler-development.title: MedlinePlus: toddler development
nlm-toddler-development.scope: Describes ages one to three and individual developmental variation.

who-motor-windows.title: WHO Motor Development Study: windows of achievement
who-motor-windows.scope: Primary longitudinal study: descriptive motor windows and non-universal crawling; not diagnostic cutoffs.

who-adolescent-development.title: WHO: adolescent health and development
who-adolescent-development.scope: Individual variation in physical and neurological development; age is one characteristic.

who-adolescent-age.title: WHO: adolescent health
who-adolescent-age.scope: Public-health definition of adolescence as ages 10–19; not the current catalog coverage.

who-ageing-report.title: WHO: World report on ageing and health
who-ageing-report.scope: Functional diversity and limitations of chronological age as a proxy for capacity.
